question: What is the meaning of end of life percentage in relation to efficiency of recycling process?
description: The end of life percentage in relation to efficiency of recycling process refers to the ratio between waste materials and reusable and/or recyclable materials generated when a building is refurbished or demolished. This indicator is called CIEnd of Life and is used to evaluate the effectiveness of the recycling process. A higher percentage indicates a more efficient recycling process.
